ORDER:

In the letter third read above, the Principal Secretary /Member Secretary, Sports Development Authority of Tamil Nadu has informed that in order to enable the coaches to deliver their work in a result oriented manner, the Government have launched “ Day Boarders Scheme” in 5 Districts (10 Centres) from the year 2011-12, and sanctioned Rs.18.00 lakhs as recurring grant in the Government Order first read above, for implementation of the said scheme.

2. Further, in order to provide systematic coaching to the identified talents from the suburban area of the district, the Government have also sanctioned Rs.51.32 lakhs as recurring grant for conducting “Week End Coaching Camps’ in 4 Districts (as in 5 Centres in each District) as continuous procedure for 8 months in a year from the financial year 2011-12 at an expenditure of Rs.15.80 lakhs per District per annum vide Government Order second read above and

Rs.63.20 lakhs afterwards.

3. Both the above said schemes were formulated before extending Sports Hostel facilities in most of the Districts. Nowadays, the Sports Hostels are functioning in all the districts except in few districts which themselves fulfilled the

objective of the above said schemes.

4. In the Sports Development Authority of Tamil Nadu — Officers review meeting held on 01.03.2016 and in the Head Office Officers meeting held on

16.03.2016 under the Chairmanship of Principal Secretary / Member Secretary, it was opined that implementation of multiple schemes results in duplication of efforts and therefore in view of the above, it has been suggested to merge the Day Boarders Scheme and Week End Coaching Camp Scheme and revitalize into one new Scheme in the name of “Talent Hunting Camp”.

5. Main objective of this scheme is to provide systematic coaching through Sports Development Authority of Tamil Nadu coaches in all District Sports Complexes for 10 boys and 10 girls, for students and non-—students under 14 age group in a popular sports discipline of the respective district, for 6 months in continuous process, i.e. 25 days in a month (except sundays — evening session only) by providing conveyance allowance, nutritious diet, sports kit, uniform etc., and the students hunting out of this scheme will be admitted into specialized academies and Sports Hostels of Sports Development Authority of Tamil Nadu.
